summary: Iteration 23 backend testing: /api/discovery exclusion set fix verified. Created 9 targeted tests covering the 4 new exclusion sources (self, friends via matches, outgoing friend_requests, incoming friend_requests), legacy swipe regression, and filter regressions. Also re-ran iterations 19-22 (45 tests) — all green.
critical_code_review_comments: discovery_router._viewer_coords does a per-request users.find_one — fine for now but should be cached with the outer users doc if a hot path.
exclude set builds three sequential async cursors; could use asyncio.gather for parallelism if latency matters (each is small/indexed, so probably negligible today).

The `.limit(1000)` caps on friend_requests / matches / swipes are silent — a power user with >1000 outgoing requests would leak excluded uids back into discovery. Consider paginating or using an aggregation $unionWith.
test_credentials: Firebase Identity Toolkit signUp with random TEST_i23_* emails; deleted after run.
seed_data_creation: Direct MongoDB inserts into `matches` (A-B), `friend_requests` (A->C outgoing, D->A incoming), and `swipes` (A->E pass for legacy regression). All cleaned up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration23.py uses direct Mongo injection (via /app/backend/db.get_db) to seed matches + friend_requests without walking the whole friend-request UI flow. Sorted user_a/user_b to match the match_key() normalization used in social_router. Module-scoped teardown removes injected docs by uid.
rca of the issue: Original /api/discovery only excluded db.swipes.from_uid==me. Once discovery flow was augmented with friend requests + matches, users who friended or requested each other still reappeared in the discovery deck, so the '24 players to discover' counter never dropped. Fix (already applied by main agent in discovery_router.py L78-93) unions three sources: legacy swipes, friend_requests (from_uid==me OR to_uid==me), and matches (user_a==me OR user_b==me). Self is also explicitly added. Verified end-to-end with 5 real Firebase users.
